WITH s AS (
 SELECT d.fiscal_year fy, d.fiscal_week wk, st.store_id sid, f.staff_purchase_flag sp, f.net_amount n
 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key=f.store_key
 WHERE d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 5 AND 8 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27')),
r AS (
 SELECT d.fiscal_year fy, d.fiscal_week wk, st.store_id sid, f.refund_net n
 FROM fact_return_line f JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.return_date JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key=f.store_key
 WHERE d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 5 AND 8 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27')),
p AS (
 SELECT d.fiscal_year fy, d.fiscal_week wk, sum(t.net_sales_before_returns) nb, sum(t.returns_net) rn, sum(t.net_sales) ns, count(DISTINCT t.store_id) stores, max(t.store_id) mxs
 FROM rpt_daily_store_sales t JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=t.business_date
 WHERE d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 5 AND 8 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27') GROUP BY 1,2)
SELECT p.fy, p.wk,
 (SELECT sum(n) FROM s WHERE s.fy=p.fy AND s.wk=p.wk AND sid<900) sales_stores,
 (SELECT sum(n) FROM s WHERE s.fy=p.fy AND s.wk=p.wk AND sid<900 AND NOT sp) sales_stores_nostaff,
 (SELECT sum(n) FROM s WHERE s.fy=p.fy AND s.wk=p.wk AND sid=900) sales_web,
 (SELECT sum(n) FROM s WHERE s.fy=p.fy AND s.wk=p.wk AND sid=999) sales_train,
 (SELECT sum(n) FROM r WHERE r.fy=p.fy AND r.wk=p.wk AND sid<900) ret_stores,
 (SELECT sum(n) FROM r WHERE r.fy=p.fy AND r.wk=p.wk AND sid=900) ret_web,
 (SELECT sum(n) FROM r WHERE r.fy=p.fy AND r.wk=p.wk AND sid=999) ret_train,
 p.nb, p.rn, p.ns, p.stores, p.mxs
FROM p ORDER BY 1,2

WITH f AS (
 SELECT f.sale_date dt, sum(f.net_amount) fnet, sum(CASE WHEN st.store_id<>999 THEN f.net_amount END) fnet_nt, count(*) n,
   count(DISTINCT f.etl_loaded_at) loads, min(f.etl_loaded_at) l1, max(f.etl_loaded_at) l2
 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key=f.store_key
 WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN '2025-05-26' AND '2025-06-22' OR f.sale_date BETWEEN '2026-06-01' AND '2026-06-28' GROUP BY 1),
r AS (SELECT business_date dt, sum(net_sales_before_returns) rnet, sum(receipts) rc FROM rpt_daily_store_sales GROUP BY 1)
SELECT f.dt, f.n, round(f.fnet,2) fnet, round(f.fnet_nt,2) fnet_nt, round(r.rnet,2) rnet, round(r.rnet-f.fnet_nt,2) diff, f.loads, f.l1, f.l2
FROM f LEFT JOIN r USING(dt) ORDER BY 1

SELECT 'sales_tz' k, count(*) n, sum(CASE WHEN CAST(sale_ts_utc + INTERVAL 3 HOUR AS DATE)<>sale_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) mismatch_plus3, sum(CASE WHEN CAST(sale_ts_utc AS DATE)<>sale_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) mismatch_utc,
  sum(CASE WHEN net_amount<=0 OR quantity<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nonpos, sum(CASE WHEN abs(gross_amount-net_amount*(1+vat_rate))>0.02 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) vatbad

SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, coalesce(o.status,'NO ORDER') status, f.channel_id, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) orders, sum(f.net_amount) net,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_return_line r WHERE r.sales_line_id IN (SELECT sales_line_id FROM fact_sales_line x WHERE x.receipt_id IN (SELECT web_order_id FROM fact_web_order WHERE status='cancelled'))) ret_on_cancelled
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
LEFT JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
WHERE s.store_id=900 AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 5 AND 8 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27')
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3,4

WITH sales AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, sum(f.net_amount) AS sales_net
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
  WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND d.fiscal_period = 2 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27')
  GROUP BY 1, 2),
returns AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, sum(r.refund_net) AS refunds_net
  FROM fact_return_line r
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = r.return_date
  WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND d.fiscal_period = 2 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27')
  GROUP BY 1, 2),
weekly AS (
  SELECT s.fiscal_year, s.fiscal_week, s.sales_net - coalesce(r.refunds_net, 0) AS net_sales
  FROM sales s LEFT JOIN returns r USING (fiscal_year, fiscal_week))
SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 2 AS fiscal_period, t.fiscal_week,
       round(t.net_sales, 2) AS net_sales_this_year, round(l.net_sales, 2) AS net_sales_last_year,
       round(100.0 * (t.net_sales / l.net_sales - 1), 2) AS growth_pct
FROM weekly t JOIN weekly l ON l.fiscal_week = t.fiscal_week AND l.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
WHERE t.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' ORDER BY t.fiscal_week

SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_sales_line f LEFT JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key WHERE s.store_key IS NULL) orphan_sales,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_return_line f LEFT JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key WHERE s.store_key IS NULL) orphan_returns,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM dim_date WHERE fiscal_period=2 AND fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27')) period_days,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM dim_date d WHERE fiscal_period=2 AND fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27') AND is_trading_day=false) closed_days
